q: What is meant by Evolution of Economic life?
a: Write down its various stages? Answer. 1. Evolution of Economic life: The constant efforts of man, have awarded him with the present Economic progress and prosperity. For millions of years, he has been busy improving his Economy. Science and Technology are also responsible for present Economic development and progress. Life was very difficult to lead at the beginning of civilization, which has passed through many stages and has reached to present developed and refined Economic Position. 2. Stages of Economic life: a. Hunting and Gathering Stage: Man was unknown to civilized life in the beginning and lived on hunting. He invented tools and weapons, made of stone, wood, and metals, like hammers, axes, daggers, knives and arrows to hunt and kill the animals, This was an uncertain way of getting food. Thus for many a time, he was left without food. This condition led him to store animals by catching them alive. Thus he started gathering animals. It is called the "Hunting and gathering stage" in Economics. b. Pastoral Stage: The existence of the Pastoral stage was the result of hunting, gathering and storing animals, like goats, sheep, cows and horses. Water and grass, at least, were necessary to feed these animals. The man started roaming from place to place, with his cattle in search of grass and water that is why this period is called the "Pastoral Stage". The tribes, the private property, precious stones, metals, food, clothing animals and transportation were the main features of the Pastoral Stage. The man, who owned many animals in his cattle, was said to be rich and wealthy.

q: Describe the division of labor, feudal exchange economy and private and public forms of ownership?
a: Answer. 1. Division of labor: The cattle rearing and plant cultivation by the bank of rivers encouraged the tribes' system and thus the division of labor among different occupations existed rapidly. The man began to grow food crops for himself and for his cattle but he was unable to produce all the things, he wanted. That is why different occupations were adopted by different groups of people such as families and villages. Thus the division of labor helped man to meet his wants. The tribal concept of occupational division of labor is said to be the main concept of the Agricultural Stage. 2. Feudal Exchange Economy: The needs of human beings increased day by day and the small production of handicrafts was unable to meet them. People started establishing cottage Industries. They exchanged their surplus production among themselves and fulfilled their wants. The ploughs the sickles the axes and the spades were invented during that period being the agricultural stage. This economy was mostly concerned with feudalism that is why this stage is called "The Feudal Exchange Economy". 3. Private and Public ownership: Under private ownership, all the productive resources are given to people to use for production. The owner gets profit after meeting the expenses of factors of production. This system is generally called "Capitalism". While under Public ownership the state remains the master or owner of all the productive resources. In this system, the resources are fully utilized for the welfare and prosperity of people, leaving profit motives aside.
